 Bigg Boss 20: ScoutOP Pushes Yung DSA During Captaincy Task, Faces Four Strict Punishments
 Mahi Pillai | 10.NOV.2026 Link copied to clipboard 
 A captaincy task inside Bigg Boss 20 took an ugly turn after ScoutOP and Yung DSA got into a heated argument. The two contestants exchanged abuses before ScoutOP pushed Yung DSA during the fight. The incident left the housemates dealing with a tense situation, and Bigg Boss had to step in and stop the task. ScoutOP later went up to Yung DSA and apologised for his behaviour. However, the apology did not mean he would escape the consequences. Bigg Boss announced four punishments for him.
 ScoutOP Pushes Yung DSA During Bigg Boss 20 Captaincy Task 
 The clash reportedly happened during the second round of the captaincy task. According to Bigg Boss Tak, a social media account that shares updates about the show, Uditi Singh was sitting on a robot chair. Team A’s job was to make her emotional enough to cry. ScoutOP tried to upset Uditi Singh by slightly burning one corner of her family photograph. Gullu and Yung DSA kept interrupting him and commenting on what he was doing. ScoutOP asked them to stay away, but the exchange continued. ScoutOP and Yung DSA soon started hurling abuses at each other. The argument did not stop there. ScoutOP lost his temper and pushed Yung, who immediately reacted by saying he no longer considered him a friend. Bigg Boss had to step in and call off the task. To avoid another clash, ScoutOP was told to stay in the bedroom area, while Yung DSA was asked to move to the garden.
 Here’s an X post shared by Bigg Boss announcing the four punishments for ScoutOP following his fight with Yung DSA: 
 🚨BREAKING: SCOUT OP FACES 4 MAJOR PUNISHMENTS AFTER PHYSICAL FIGHT WITH YUNG DSA!
Bigg Boss takes STRICT action against Scout following the physical fight with Yung DSA!
Here are the 4 major punishments announced:
• Nominated for the ENTIRE SEASON!
• No more Captaincy…
— BBTak (@BiggBoss_Tak) November 9, 2026 
 ScoutOP Apologises, But Amrapali Is Not Happy 
 Once he had calmed down, ScoutOP went to Yung DSA and apologised for pushing him. Yung DSA did not accept the apology immediately. He walked away but eventually forgave ScoutOP. Amrapali did not agree with how Yung DSA had handled the situation. She questioned him for accepting the apology and said that doing so could send the wrong message to the viewers. She wanted him to ask Bigg Boss to take strict action against ScoutOP. Amrapali also told Yung DSA that if Bigg Boss failed to take action, he should think about walking out of the show.
 Bigg Boss Announces Four Punishments For ScoutOP 
 Bigg Boss eventually announced four punishments for ScoutOP. He will stay nominated for the rest of the season and cannot take part in any more captaincy tasks. He will also lose the chance to receive any special powers in the house. The final punishment gives Bigg Boss the right to evict ScoutOP at any point during the season.
